chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), he said to the Kharijites, and he had gone out to their camp while they were persisting in rejecting the Arbitration, so he said (peace be upon him):

key_terms.الْحُكْمَة: The Arbitration (Sulh al-Hukm), referring to the event after the Battle of Siffin.
key_terms.خَوَارِج: Kharijites, a specific group known for their rebellion and theological deviations.

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's address to the Kharijites regarding the Arbitration?
ai.summary: This introduction sets the stage for Imam Ali’s (AS) address to the Kharijites at Dhu Qar, specifically targeting their rigid rejection of the Arbitration (Hukm) between him and Muawiyah. It underscores the historical tension where Ali sought to preserve unity through a pragmatic political solution, while the Kharijites viewed it as a deviation from divine decree, a key event in the transition from the Rashidun Caliphate to the Umayyad era.
